description: A light-dependent-resistor sensor module with both a digital threshold output and an analog light-level output.
how_to_use: VCC/GND power, DO is a digital output (goes low when darkness is detected, on-board LED lights up), AO is an analog output proportional to light level (read with analogRead()). DO isn't a real I2C/SPI bus pin despite the name overlap with other parts' SDA-style legs.

plain.what: Senses light — the number goes up or down as it gets brighter or darker.
plain.how: VCC, GND, and the AO pin to an analog pin to read how bright it is. DO switches on/off at a level you set with the little screw.
